events.title: CSR Voluntary Guidelines
changes: MCA issues India's first formal CSR guidelines — voluntary, under the old Companies Act, 1956, which had no CSR provision
Signals CSR as part of corporate governance

events.title: DPE CSR guidelines for central PSUs
changes: Department of Public Enterprises issues CSR guidelines for central public sector enterprises
First structured CSR budgets for PSUs

events.title: National Voluntary Guidelines (NVGs)
changes: Nine principles on social, environmental and economic responsibilities of business
Replaces the 2009 guidelines; later evolves into the NGRBC (2019)

events.title: SEBI Business Responsibility Reports
changes: Top 100 listed companies must file Business Responsibility Reports aligned to the NVGs
First mandatory responsibility disclosure

events.title: Companies Act, 2013 enacted with Section 135
changes: Mandates CSR committee, policy and 2% spend for companies above thresholds
'Comply or explain' model — unspent amounts only had to be explained

events.title: CSR Policy Rules and Schedule VII notified
changes: Companies (CSR Policy) Rules, 2014 notified (G.S.R. 130(E))
Defines eligible activities, implementing agencies, reporting format

events.title: Mandatory CSR comes into force
changes: Section 135 effective from 1 April 2014
India becomes the first country to legally mandate CSR spending

events.title: Tax: CSR is not a business expense
changes: Finance (No. 2) Act, 2014 inserts Explanation 2 to Section 37(1) of the Income-tax Act
CSR spend cannot be deducted as business expenditure (80G claims remain litigated)

events.title: Early Schedule VII amendments
changes: Amendments of 6 Aug and 24 Oct 2014 add and clarify items — including slum area development (item xi)

events.title: Disaster management added — item (xii)
changes: Relief, rehabilitation and reconstruction become eligible CSR (G.S.R. 390(E), 30 May 2019)

events.title: Companies (Amendment) Act, 2019
changes: Introduces the Unspent CSR Account and transfer timelines
Proposed imprisonment for non-compliance (later replaced before it came into force)

events.title: R&D and incubators widened — item (ix)
changes: Contributions to government-funded incubators and to public research bodies (ICAR, ICMR, CSIR etc.) for SDG-linked research made eligible

events.title: PM CARES Fund added to item (viii)
changes: Notified 26 May 2020, deemed effective 28 March 2020 — COVID-era contributions count as CSR

events.title: CAPF & CPMF veterans added to item (vi)
changes: Central Armed Police Forces and Central Para Military Forces veterans and dependants, including widows, become eligible beneficiaries

events.title: Item (ix) substituted again
changes: G.S.R. 525(E) widens the list of research institutions and incubators eligible for CSR contributions

events.title: Companies (Amendment) Act, 2020 — decriminalisation
changes: Replaces imprisonment with monetary penalty (Section 135(7))
Allows set-off of excess spend
No CSR Committee needed if obligation ≤ ₹50 lakh

events.title: New CSR regime in force (22 Jan 2021)
changes: 2019 and 2020 amendments to Section 135 commence
CSR Amendment Rules 2021: CSR-1 registration, ongoing projects, Unspent CSR Account, impact assessment, 5% overhead cap, capital-asset rules
Non-compliance becomes a civil wrong with penalties

events.title: SEBI BRSR replaces BRR
changes: Quantitative ESG disclosure for listed companies; mandatory for the top 1,000 from FY 2022-23

events.title: CSR Amendment Rules 2022
changes: Companies with money in the Unspent CSR Account must have a CSR Committee
Revised annual report format and other clarifications

events.title: SEBI BRSR Core
changes: Nine ESG attributes requiring independent assurance, phased from top 150 to top 1,000

events.title: GST: input credit blocked on CSR
changes: Section 17(5)(fa) of the CGST Act blocks ITC on goods and services used for CSR, from 1 Oct 2023

events.title: SEBI eases BRSR Core
changes: 'Assessment or assurance' allowed; value-chain disclosure deferred and made voluntary; green credits indicator added

events.title: Revised e-Form CSR-1
changes: Tighter documentation and professional certification for implementing-agency registration (from 14 July 2025)

events.title: Companies (Amendment) Bill, 2025 introduced
changes: Proposes lower thresholds: net worth ₹100 crore, turnover ₹500 crore, net profit ₹3 crore
Proposes a CSR-experienced director on the committee

events.title: Corporate Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 introduced
changes: Net-profit trigger ₹5 crore → ₹10 crore
Unspent CSR Account transfer 30 → 90 days
Committee exemption ₹50 lakh → ₹1 crore

events.title: Social Stock Exchange route — Rule 4A & item (xiii)
changes: Up to 10% of annual CSR via ZCZP instruments on the Social Stock Exchange
No impact assessment needed for those projects; NPO must finish in 3 years

events.title: JPC report on the 2026 Bill
changes: Backs the ₹10 crore trigger but recommends removing the government's power to revise it
Bill not yet passed

events.title: Draft CSR Amendment Rules 2026 & new Schedule VII
changes: MCA public notice of 11 Nov 2026; comments till 11 Dec 2026
Impact assessment made voluntary; CSR-1 de-registration and cancellation of implementing agencies
Schedule VII rewritten (mental health, PM Internship, career counselling, sports care); heritage item narrowed
Draft only — not yet notified
